description: Change a release gate pack's name, description, or tests. tests and schedules each replace that kind of test in the pack as a whole, so read the pack with list_gate_packs first and send every test it should keep. Every gate that runs the pack runs the new tests from its next run; past runs keep what they ran.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

schedule.description: The schedule's id, as list_schedules shows it.
schedule.title: Schedule

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

test.description: The saved test's id, as list_tests shows it.
test.title: Test

pack.description: The pack's id or name, as list_gate_packs shows it.
pack.title: Pack

schedules.description: Scheduled tests, each {"project": number or name, "schedule": id}, as list_schedules shows them. Replaces the pack's schedules; leave it out to keep them.
schedules.title: Schedules

tests.description: Saved tests, each {"project": number or name, "test": id}. A pack may hold tests of several projects. Replaces the pack's saved tests; leave it out to keep them.
tests.title: Tests

name: update_gate_pack
